items.source: Obtain the ApplicationContext for actual use.
items.translation: 获取用于实际使用的ApplicationContext。

items.source: Get the default charset, used when the content type does not contain one.
items.translation: 获取默认字符集，当content type不包含该字符集时使用。

items.source: The default implementation looks in the ApplicationContext for a RequestDataValueProcessor bean with the name REQUEST_DATA_VALUE_PROCESSOR_BEAN_NAME.
items.translation: 默认实现会在ApplicationContext中查找名为REQUEST_DATA_VALUE_PROCESSOR_BEAN_NAME的RequestDataValueProcessorbean。

items.source: Default is "text/html;charset=UTF-8".
items.translation: 默认值为"text/html;charset=UTF-8"。

items.source: Default is UTF 8.
items.translation: 默认值为UTF 8。

items.source: Default is none (null).
items.translation: 默认值为无（null）。

items.source: Should never be null if the view was correctly configured.
items.translation: 如果视图已正确配置，则不应为null。

items.source: The default implementation creates a standard RequestContext instance for the given exchange and model.
items.translation: 默认实现会为给定的交换（exchange）和模型创建标准的 `RequestContext` 实例。

items.source: Framework code must call this when constructing views.
items.translation: 框架代码在构建视图时必须调用此方法。

items.source:
The default implementation creates a combined output Map that includes
model as well as static attributes with the former taking precedence.
items.translation: 默认实现会创建一个组合输出 Map，其中包含模型和静态属性，且前者具有优先权。

items.source: Can be overridden in subclasses to create custom instances.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写以创建自定义实例。

items.source: Use the configured ReactiveAdapterRegistry to adapt asynchronous attributes to Mono<T> or Mono<List<T>> and then wait to resolve them into actual values. When the returned Mono<Void> completes, the asynchronous attributes in the model will have been replaced with their corresponding resolved values.
items.translation: 使用配置的ReactiveAdapterRegistry将异步属性适配为Mono<T>或Mono<List<T>>，然后等待将其解析为实际值。当返回的Mono<Void>完成时，模型中的异步属性将被其对应的解析值替换。

items.source: Use the configured ReactiveAdapterRegistry to adapt asynchronous attributes to Mono<T> or Mono<List<T>> and then wait to resolve them into actual values.
items.translation: 使用配置的ReactiveAdapterRegistry将异步属性适配为Mono<T>或Mono<List<T>>，然后等待将其解析为实际值。

items.source: Create a RequestContext to expose under the specified attribute name.
items.translation: 创建 `RequestContext` 并将其暴露为 指定的属性名称。

items.source: Get the RequestDataValueProcessor to use.
items.translation: 获取要使用的RequestDataValueProcessor。

items.source: Get the name of the RequestContext attribute for this view, if any.
items.translation: 获取此视图的RequestContext属性的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Set the default charset for this view, used when the content type does not contain one.
items.translation: 为此视图设置默认字符集，在 内容类型 不包含字符集时使用。

items.source: Logger that is available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Well-known name for the RequestDataValueProcessor in the bean factory.
items.translation: bean 工厂中 RequestDataValueProcessor 的知名名称。

items.source: Get the configured media types supported by this view.
items.translation: 获取此视图支持的已配置媒体类型。

items.source: Prepare the model to render.
items.translation: 准备模型以进行渲染。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to actually render the view.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法才能实际渲染视图。

items.source: getSupportedMediaTypes in interface View
items.translation: `getSupportedMediaTypes` 接口 `View` 中

items.source: render in interface View
items.translation: `render` 接口 `View`

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。

items.source: contentType - the content type selected to render with, which should match one of the supported media types
items.translation: `contentType` - 用于渲染所选的内容类型，应与支持的媒体类型之一匹配。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the ApplicationContext cannot be obtained
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果无法获取 ApplicationContext

items.source: model - a map with attribute names as keys and corresponding model objects as values (the map can also be null in case of an empty model)
items.translation: model - 一个以属性名称为键、对应模型对象为值的映射（如果模型为空，该映射也可以为 null）

items.source: model - a combined output Map (never null), with dynamic values taking precedence over static attributes
items.translation: model - 一个组合输出 Map（永远不为 null），其动态值优先于静态属性。

items.source: the RequestDataValueProcessor, or null if there is none in the application context
items.translation: `RequestDataValueProcessor`，或者如果应用程序上下文中没有则为 `null`。

items.source: renderAttributes - combined output Map (never null), with dynamic values taking precedence over static attributes
items.translation: renderAttributes - 组合输出 Map（永远不为 null），动态值优先于静态属性。

items.source: contentType - the content type selected to render with, which should match one of the supported media types
items.translation: contentType - 用于渲染所选的内容类型，应与支持的媒体类型之一匹配。

items.source: exchange - the current exchange
items.translation: exchange - 当前交易所

items.source: a Mono that represents when and if rendering succeeds
items.translation: 一个代表渲染何时及是否成功的Mono。

items.source: result a Mono that completes when the model is ready
items.translation: 结果是一个在模型就绪时完成的Mono。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method. Invoked after ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader), ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) and MessageSourceAware, if applicable.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。
